title: The ZAP website: zaproxy.org
description: Dated facts about the zaproxy.org domain, the repositories behind the site, and the January 2020 commits that point ZAP's own files at it.
narrative:
A user who follows a link from ZAP's own files probably expects it to reach the project's current website. The zaproxy.org domain was registered in November 2015, according to its RDAP record. In the weeks after, the zaproxy GitHub organisation gained a repository for ZAP swag artwork, and in December 2015 another repository described as the ZAP website.

The first commit in the zaproxy-website repository, dated July 2016, is titled "Basic setup - gulp + webpack + hugo". The earliest Internet Archive capture of www.zaproxy.org dates from June 2016. The zaproxy logo notes say the 2017 logo was designed as part of the design of the new ZAP website.

ZAP's own files began pointing at the new site in January 2020. On 14 January zap-extensions had a commit updating the Getting Started Guide's website links, and the next day zap-core-help had Update for new website, merged as pull request #293. The zaproxy commit that changed to zaproxy.org landed on 16 January, the day before the 2.9.0 release tag. GitHub lists the zaproxy-website repository as created in January 2020, described as the source of the ZAP website, although its first commit is from 2016.

Today GitHub lists the repository's homepage as zaproxy.org and its licence as MIT. The website's code began in 2016, so it predates the repository that holds it.

chapters.title: The domain and the first repositories, 2015
chapters.text: The registry's RDAP record gives zaproxy.org a registration date of 2015-11-04. On GitHub, the zaproxy organisation's zap-swag repository (artwork for ZAP swag) was created on 2015-11-16 and zaproxy.github.io, described as "ZAP Website", on 2015-12-16.

chapters.title: A Hugo site, 2016 and 2017
chapters.text: The first commit in the zaproxy-website repository is dated 2016-07-03 and titled "Basic setup - gulp + webpack + hugo". The Internet Archive's earliest capture of www.zaproxy.org is from 2016-06-08. In 2017 the zaproxy logo notes record that the new logo was designed "as part of the design of the new ZAP website" (see the logo story).

chapters.title: January 2020: ZAP's files point at the new site
chapters.text: On 2020-01-14 zap-extensions has "Getting Started Guide - updated website links", on 2020-01-15 zap-core-help has "Update for new website" (merged as pull request #293 from psiinon/new-website) and on 2020-01-16 zaproxy has "Changed to use zaproxy.org", the day before the ZAP 2.9.0 tag. GitHub shows the zaproxy-website repository as created on 2020-01-27, with the description "The source of ZAP website", homepage https://www.zaproxy.org and the MIT licence, although its first commit is from 2016.
